$comment: Frozen machine-readable contract for the reverse-skill deterministic document index (PageIndex-style tree + SQLite FTS5, no vector database). Single source of machine truth: tests and gates validate the implementation against this file; do not fork a second manifest into docs, tests, or skills.

node_id.derivation: first 16 hex chars of sha256(relative_path + '\u0000' + tree_path + '\u0000' + occurrence) where occurrence is the 1-based index among same-title siblings under the same parent

tree_path.note: Ordinary heading/symbol titles stay readable. In identity segments, '~', '/', and '@' are escaped as '~0', '~1', and '~2'; duplicate same-title siblings after the first receive an '@N' suffix. This makes every structural path collision-free.

error_codes.index_path_not_found: target workspace path does not exist or is not a directory
error_codes.index_not_found: index file does not exist at the resolved path; run 'index build --apply' first
error_codes.index_corrupt: index file is not a readable SQLite database
error_codes.index_schema_incompatible: index schema_version does not match this build
error_codes.index_capability_unavailable: SQLite FTS5/trigram required by the schema is unavailable
error_codes.parser_unavailable: the requested syntax parser is not installed or not present in the approved cache
error_codes.index_blocked: requested operation was blocked by a safety boundary
error_codes.node_not_found: node_id does not exist in the index
error_codes.invalid_node_id: node_id does not match the frozen node_id regex
error_codes.ida_export_invalid: the explicit IDA export is absent, malformed, unsafe, or has unresolved xrefs

score_model.bm25_rank_score: 1/(1+rank) where rank is the 0-based position after (bm25 rank, node_id) ordering

read_only_guarantee: status, inspect, and retrieve never write; build/update without --apply only emit plans and never create the index directory.
